This workshop explored Europe’s 5G progress, Digital Decade targets and future connectivity indicators as EU stakeholders assess the path from 5G to 6G.

The study on the review of the Digital Decade assessed the Digital Decade’s priorities, targets, indicators and governance framework, providing a basis for the Commission’s forthcoming review.
On 30 July, the Commission organised an information session for the call for proposals “Youth-Driven Social Media Design”.
Member States’ input on these indicators will serve as an important basis for the foreseen Commission report on the GIA, planned for May 2028.
In a clear demonstration of its commitment to simplification and timely implementation, the Commission today published practical guidance to help manufacturers, developers, and businesses of all sizes meet their obligations under the Cyber Resilience Act.
The Commission has published the annual country reports, from National Regulatory Authorities for telecommunications, on the implementation of the provisions on open internet.
The report sets out practical strategies to overcome the barriers that still limit the sharing and reuse of open source software across the public sector.
This study explores how connectivity is shaping the adoption of precision farming technologies across Europe. It identifies the challenges and infrastructure needed to support the sector's digital transformation.
